data.name: Lucetta
data.gender_notes: Lucetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lucetta is derived from the Latin word ‘lucet’, which means ‘to shine’. In Christian tradition, the name Lucetta is a female variant of Lucius, which is a Roman name meaning ‘bringer of light’. The name Lucetta is also associated with St. Lucia, a third-century Sicilian saint known for her faith and charity. St. Lucia is said to have brought light to her community during a time of darkness by wearing candles on her head to light her way as she went about her daily tasks.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith, hope, and light in the darkness.
data.etymology: Lucetta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lucetta total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Today, the name Lucetta can be seen as a reminder of the power and importance of light, both literally and figuratively, in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lucetta is deeply rooted in Christian tradition and symbolizes the light of faith, hope, and charity in the world. It is a reminder of the power of the human spirit to bring light and light the way forward, even in the darkest of times. The name Lucetta also honors St. Lucia, a patron saint of the blind, students, and those in danger at sea.
